# Bundled example image

`melendez-still-life.jpg` is used by `vignette("line-extraction")`.

- Object: *Still Life with Fish, Bread, and Kettle*, c. 1772, oil on canvas.
- Artist: Luis Meléndez (Spanish, 1716–1780).
- Collection: The Cleveland Museum of Art, accession number 1983.97.
- Record: https://clevelandart.org/art/1983.97
- Source file: https://openaccess-cdn.clevelandart.org/1983.97/1983.97_web.jpg
  (1247 × 893 px), retrieved 2026-11-20 through the museum's Open Access API
  (https://openaccess-api.clevelandart.org/api/artworks/151555), whose record
  gives `share_license_status: "CC0"`.
- Licence: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0 Universal public domain
  dedication), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Changes: downsampled to 640 × 458 px by averaging over pixel blocks, saved as
  JPEG at quality 0.9 (66,356 bytes).
